name: Bus Voltage Deviation
description: Voltage at a low-voltage bus with high PV penetration. Checks whether voltage quality standards are met.

elements.name: Bus Voltage Magnitude
elements.description: Steady-state bus voltage at maximum PV generation and minimum load. Uncertain due to cloud cover intermittency.

uncertainty.source: Quasi-static time-series simulation with irradiance data

elements.name: Maximum Allowable Voltage
elements.description: EN 50160 upper voltage limit for LV distribution networks

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(V_bus) = V_bus if V_bus <= V_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The EN 50160 overvoltage limit guards the bus voltage uncertainty set; voltages above 1.10 pu damage equipment and force inverter disconnection.
